prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1354; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Officer's narrative: On arrival at the intersection in League City, Texas, I found a rear-end collision involving two passenger vehicles. Driver 1 was stopped in the travel lane when the vehicle operated by Driver 2 struck the rear bumper area. Driver 1 reported pain in the left wrist and was transported for evaluation. The injury reported is consistent with the force and direction of the impact, and the damage to the rear of Driver 1's vehicle matches the described collision. Officers on scene confirmed Driver 1 was inside the vehicle at the time of impact, and a Passenger was also present in the front seat. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was known or observed. Scene photographs document some of the reported details. No independent witnesses were located. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. Vehicles were moved to the shoulder, and traffic was directed until the scene was cleared.
